intro: The South Bay is dense with general aviation — Reid-Hillview and Palo Alto are two of the busiest training fields in California, and San Jose Mineta sits right between them. Ground-level public safety is on the digital Silicon Valley Regional system and out of reach, so the airband and the college stations are the payoff here.
introz: 南湾通航极其密集——Reid-Hillview 和帕洛阿尔托是加州最繁忙的训练机场之一，圣何塞机场就夹在中间。地面公共安全已迁到硅谷区域数字系统，收不到；这里的乐趣在航空波段和大学电台。

stations.d: Airline traffic plus a steady stream of business jets. Audible across much of the valley floor.
stations.dz: 航班加上络绎不绝的公务机。谷地大部分平地都能收到。

stations.d: Quickest way to get real wind and ceiling numbers for the whole South Bay.
stations.dz: 获取整个南湾真实风向和云底高最快的方式。

stations.d: Relentless pattern work from flight schools. If you want to learn what standard tower phraseology sounds like, this is the frequency to sit on.
stations.dz: 飞行学校无休止的起落航线训练。想学标准塔台用语，守这个频率最合适。

stations.d: Now largely a Google/NASA operation. Activity is sporadic but unusual aircraft show up.
stations.dz: 现在主要是 Google/NASA 在用。活动零散，但常有稀奇机型出现。

stations.d: Glider and vintage-aircraft field south of Gilroy.
stations.dz: 吉尔罗伊以南的滑翔机与老式飞机机场。

stations.z: NOAA 蒙特雷 / 南湾边缘
stations.d: Sometimes stronger than the SF transmitter in the far South Bay and Santa Cruz Mountains.
stations.dz: 在南湾南端和圣克鲁兹山区，有时比旧金山台更强。

stations.z: W6UW 圣塔克拉拉县业余电台协会
stations.d: Santa Clara County Amateur Radio Association's machine. Regular evening nets.
stations.dz: 圣塔克拉拉县业余电台协会的中继，晚间有固定通联网。

stations.d: From Mount Umunhum or Lick Observatory this reaches an enormous area. One of the best handheld radio spots in California.
stations.dz: 在 Umunhum 山或 Lick 天文台，这个频率能覆盖极大范围。加州最好的手台高点之一。

stations.z: 加州公路巡警圣何塞区（低波段）
stations.d: Scan the 39.2–39.9 MHz block along 101, 280 or 880. Low band is analog and carries a long way.
stations.dz: 沿 101、280 或 880 号公路扫 39.2–39.9 MHz。低波段是模拟制式，传得很远。

stations.n: San Jose PD / Fire — P25 digital
stations.z: 圣何塞警消 · P25 数字
stations.d: The Silicon Valley Regional Communications System is 700 MHz P25 trunked. Not decodable by the VX-6.
stations.dz: 硅谷区域通信系统采用 700 MHz P25 集群，VX-6 无法解码。

stations.z: CAL FIRE 圣塔克拉拉分区
stations.d: Analog VHF. Busy in the Diablo Range and Santa Cruz Mountains during fire season.
stations.dz: 模拟 VHF。火季期间迪亚布罗山脉和圣克鲁兹山区很忙。

stations.d: Scan 450–460 MHz near light rail lines; many transit agencies remain analog UHF.
stations.dz: 在轻轨沿线扫 450–460 MHz；许多公交机构仍用模拟 UHF。

stations.n: KFJC — Foothill College, Los Altos Hills
stations.z: KFJC 山麓学院（洛斯阿尔托斯山）
stations.d: Transmitter is right here in the South Bay, so this is where the signal is cleanest. Freeform, uncompromising, frequently astonishing.
stations.dz: 发射台就在南湾，信号最干净。自由形式，毫不妥协，经常让人惊艳。

stations.d: Student-run, strong electronic, hip-hop and metal blocks.
stations.dz: 学生自主运营，电子、嘻哈、金属时段都很强。

stations.d: Volunteer community station, decades old, wildly eclectic.
stations.dz: 已有数十年历史的志愿者社区电台，节目极其多元。

stations.d: Low power — you need to be fairly close.
stations.dz: 功率很小，需要靠得比较近。

stations.d: Try a pass from the summit of Mount Umunhum — clear horizon in most directions.
stations.dz: 在 Umunhum 山顶试试过顶——多数方向地平线都很开阔。

stations.d: Occasionally used around large event venues and highway construction.
stations.dz: 大型活动场馆和高速施工区偶尔使用。
